_comment: Pulled live from macro_indicators / big_cycle_metrics / big_cycle_stage_audit_log on 2026-11-17, per Phase 0 of docs/specs/debt-metrics-integrity-v2.md. All values pulled directly, not hand-typed.

card.name: Indirect Bidder Share (10Y/30Y)
card.threshold_source: fetch-macro-data INDICATORS statusFn: v > 65 healthy / v >= 55 watch / else danger

classifier.note: 57.55 is 0.05pts above the 57.5 gate -- not weak, but within noise of flipping either way on a single auction

trip_wire.threshold: evalAuctionDemandDeterioration: armed if the last 6 consolidated (per-term-averaged) readings are ALL < 65%
trip_wire.problem: consolidated readings run ~55-58% structurally (see distribution in decisions log) -- the 65% threshold, inherited unchanged from the old per-auction check, can never be crossed by this metric's current regime, so the trip-wire is effectively permanently armed

net_interest_pct_receipts.note: 0.179pts below the gate -- a single month of MTS data could flip this

frozen_cpi_cluster.note: all three share the same root cause: yoyPair's all-or-nothing refusal to pair across the CPIAUCSL gap at 2025-10-01

Real Fed Funds Rate.note: status is still the OLD healthy/watch/danger family, not v1 Phase 3b's stance labels -- this card has never successfully re-run since that code deployed, because of this same frozen-CPI gap

convergence_gap.indicator_name: Effective Rate vs. Nominal Growth (r_eff - g)
convergence_gap.note: spec text cites 1.72; live value today is 1.774 -- normal day-to-day drift from DGS10/r_eff updates, not a discrepancy to chase

redfin_card.note: confirmed in v1 Phase 4: Redfin's public S3 file (redfin-public-data.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com) returns HTTP 403; v1 worked around this for the Gaps determinant's text only, not for this card itself
